Seven omitted records are not missing runtime rank progression: game-content development.practice contains explicit profiles for all 95 combat abilities; each supports rank 1–20 with authored general progression and milestones. The seven detailed profile records above show actual runtime values and provenance notes.

weaknessResolutionPolicy.runtimeRule: Do not present tags/interrupts/objectives as an elemental weakness. Legacy encounter rows have no authored per-enemy weakness. Scenario adaptations add interrupts/objective mechanics but no vulnerable-damage multiplier.

scenarioFindings.Hoarder: Emergence interrupted by Frozen, Shocked, Burning status, or burning tile; this is interruption of a spawn mechanic, not a damage weakness.
scenarioFindings.Juicer: Flaming throw interrupted by Frozen/Shocked or displacement; toppled bench intercepts a plate. The source-described vulnerable veins are not implemented as a weak-point damage rule.
scenarioFindings.Ball of Swine: A complete Speedbump stops and damages the boss; this is an objective interaction, not elemental weakness.

weaknessResolutionPolicy.immunityImplementationNote: RulesEngine checks EntityState.Immunities against incoming action tags, but current authored enemy records do not populate such weaknesses/immunities; no vulnerability multiplier is authored in these records.
